reviews.text: On a Sunday evening, my10 year old pitty wanted to be a pup and chase some deer. He came back with a tear in his skin from branches. I called up NWEAE for assistance, and they were available. Dr. Manning patched up my old guy and sent us on our way in a few hours. Night Watch has a solid team ready to help you with unscheduled vet emergencies. 10/10, hopefully dont have to see again, but will if we have too!
My dog was sick and she had to go to this one because it was and I checked everyone this was really helping my dog really really bad

Amazing staff!! They were extremely kind and patient with Thor and I- and had a great experience w them after having complicated neutering experience with another clinic
They took amazing care of Thor!! definitely worth the visit because they rlly do care a lot :)

Once upon a time, there was this beautiful princess named Aurora. And she was the fairest of them all… energetic, loving obsessed with Harry Potter, belly rubs, and stuffy’s and anything bacon related…  sadly the beautiful princess decided to have a squirrel for dinner and hurt her paw trying to chase the squirrel while her mama tried to fix it. It got much worse and the fairy godmother named Google said that Nightwatch was the grandest of them all! And boy was fairy godmother. Google right… We were told there was a great and powerful wizard. Very similar to Dumbledore named Dr. Manning who had these incredible trusted sidekicks named Kelli and Alexandria who went above and beyond to help princess Aurora while also consoling her dramatic basket case mom… they gave the best belly rubs, the most awesome snacks and even better cuddles with Dr. Manning even laying on the floor to comfort Princess Aurora. Kelly and Alexandra were so gracious and so kind and supportive in every moment and interaction making sure that princess Aurora got to keep her her trusty baby stuffy Max… there will never be a greater experience for veterinary care than Dr. Manning and his team.

I say all that to be silly because we had such a rough night and I have immeasurable gratitude for everything the night watch team did to take care of my sweet girl, my daughter and even me. Aurora is my service dog and my very best friend. and they did everything in their power and more to make sure she had the ultimate best care I have never seen a team, more passionate and caring and loving towards animals, than their team last night. I don’t care if you have to drive from hundreds of miles away it’s worth it!!! the details, the precision, the care everything that was put into taking care of Aurora, blew my mind for people to care so much about the work that they do.
Dr. Manning, thank you for everything that you did to take care of my sweet girl. I will never be able to thank you enough or Alexandra or Kelly or any of the others that were there last night. I truly hope that God blesses you and your family.

If you’re looking for a place to donate blankets, dog beds, treats anything to help animals and you wanted to go to a good cause do not look any further than this place the care that they put towards the families of these animals, but comfort that they provide is unmatched

Dr.manning,Alexandra and Kelly were absolutely phenomenal and Dr.manning even laid down on the floor while taking care of my sister.Alexandra brought us extra blankets and made sure we were at least somewhat comfortable. And Kelly was super nice and sweet and she made sure my sister (aurora) was comfortable and ok.

The stabilization and care for our pet has been excellent. We left with a comprehensive plan for treatment and follow up recommendations for our general practice vet.  Floyd was very thorough in reviewing the records that we brought with us and answered all of our questions and concerns before discharge.

We had an emergency with our 10 week old puppy on a Saturday night. After calling around to a few different emergency vets, Night Watch Elite Animal Emergency was able to see us right away and take care of our pup. Dr. Floyd was absolutely wonderful. He was very caring and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend this clinic for any pet emergencies. In the event of another emergency, they will be my first choice.

I have a foster pup that has endured a great deal in her 5 months of life. In the past 24 hours she experienced side effects from her meds. I took her into Night Watch at about 4:00 am and within that difficult time of little Rose vomiting and us waiting, we were checked on and I was given clear and detailed updates by staff, Dr Manning spent time with us going over the symptoms and then reviewing the tests and X-rays. I felt heard, I was treated with professionalism and the attention given to the visit was exceptional. I left feeling like we were going to have a better day. We still have to get through the first couple hours for the fluids and meds to kick in. But I am so assured that I can review the copy of the medical records and if the regular vet needs information, the notes and record are thorough. Thank you Night Watch

This is where I have been taking my kitty for treatments for her kidney failure and diabetes when my vet has been closed during weekends. Usually everyone there is so patient and friendly. But this last time I went, there was different staff. I had to leave my kitty for a few hrs for her treatment while on work break. I waited for 15 mins before they checked her in even though no other patient was there and I kept telling them I had to leave back to work. After my cat was checked in and I left,  a woman called upset and gave the phone to a man who said he was the boss of everyone there. They kept me on the phone for 25 mins while I was at work about why I didn't tell them she had diabetes and needed insulin at a certain time  (its in her chart and I did go over that with them this time and last time/ In addition, I paid for glucose test for her diabetes there previously- I was very clear with them multiple times what times she needs her insulin. I told them the last two visits, this one included, that her lab work was updated). They continued to argue with me on the phone about how Ive been charged wrong the last times I was there and should have been charged much more. I repeatedly told them I needed to get off the phone to get back into work , or if they needed me to skip work and pick her up I would if anything was an issue. They said just to go to work and come back, but still kept me on the phone for several more minutes. The time stamp and duration is on my phone call log. They also gave me a hard time why I didn't bring in lab paperwork for her when I told the staff last time my vet didn't give me a hardcopy of the lab results but he had them if they needed it. Nightwatch has my vets information and has emailed them in the past for information. They man gave excuses of why they couldn't email my vet for a hard copy of lab results, when email communication for information between the two facilities was never an issue before. He then asked me in an unpleasant tone if I was planning on bringing my cat in every  weekend. I finally was able to get off the phone with him. It came off as a harassing phone call. I picked my kitty back up  later and the man proceeded to show me all the extra charges he said he 'should' have tacked on and said in an entitled tone that 'at least he is not back charging me for all the fees that should have been charged as well for previous visits'. Ive already spent hundreds of dollars there. He also stated, ' what if she has kidney issues', which I told their facility last time her lab results showed kidney failure and I did mention her kidneys to them more than once this particular night. Either they didn't read the chart or was not listening to me.  Usually a wonderful place that I highly recommend. But this night with this particular staff - It was a horrible and stressful experience as a loyal client.
